_about: Hand-curated labels layered on the verbatim OutboundOS sources. Every quote must occur exactly once in the named source file (CSV rows are matched on parsed field text, markdown on raw lines); the builder fails otherwise. rejection_category and issue_code are the only interpretive fields and are marked as curated in the built fixtures. expectation: OBSERVED = the source recorded it from page markup/text; NEEDS_BROWSER_CHECK = the source said it could not confirm; MUST_NOT_CLAIM = the source withdrew it or said not to claim it.
